facts.text: After a late-September storm the first-pitch crux can be wet and iced, with snow and verglas on the summit ramp and gully.
In mid-to-late May expect thin snow through the forest, firm snow near the base, a damp first pitch, and snow on the sandy ledges and below the fin; axe and crampons are carried.
At the fork higher on the trail, the right branch heads for the Early Winter Spires and the left one for Liberty Bell.
Cams from about 0.5 to 2 cover almost everything, most of it on pitch 1; a handline on the final traverse helps newer climbers.
Near the top stay in the gully; the east side of the last traverse drops away steeply.
Thin ice can hide on holds of the final scramble after a cold snap; rope the summit ramp.

facts.text: In mid-May of a good snow year the couloir is continuous snow; parties run the rope with several pickets and a tree sling, and the final 20-30 ft is the steepest bit.
In early May the right fork is snow except one short band of mixed scree, ice and wet rock that is the crux; snow resumes above it to the ridge, where a tree with old slings marks the top.

The rappels are easy to miss: from the slung tree go to climber's-left trees, then a rock horn, then into the couloir to an anchor on climber's right (about 60 m), then down to the right fork where a tree below the left fork gives one more.
A few pickets plus a couple of nuts or cams for the mixed band (May)

notes: Packet trackChecks are identical for every route since all share the Blue Lake approach and one summit; only logged route names separate them, so tracks were assigned only to South Arete and Southwest Couloir. Southwest Rib is logged ~35 times (Jun-Sep) but is not one of our routes; Boving Roofs shares its first three pitches. Direct East Buttress and Southern Man carry a trailhead pin at 48.5143,-120.6425 (Washington Pass hairpin) rather than Blue Lake; plausible for east-side lines but not verified. Summit pins are within ~30 m of the surveyed 48.512275,-120.655395, so no summit move. Proposed season change: Southwest Couloir Apr-May rather than May-Jun.
